zh: Dragon Claw 支持多个对话同时进行：回复在服务器后台继续，切换对话、新建对话、刷新页面都不会打断；侧栏正在回复的对话显示转圈，切回去会接上已生成的内容继续显示，后台对话回复完会提示。点「停止」才真正中止。同一账号最多 3 个对话同时进行（可用 AI_MAX_PARALLEL_CHATS 调整）。
en: Dragon Claw now runs several chats in parallel: replies keep going on the server when you switch chats, start a new one or reload the page. Busy chats spin in the sidebar, reopening one picks up the reply where it is, and you get a notice when a background chat finishes. Only Stop ends a reply. Up to 3 chats per account at once (AI_MAX_PARALLEL_CHATS).
